name: FmSynth
brief: Two-operator FM synthesizer with ADSR envelope.
description:
Classic FM synthesis with a carrier and modulator oscillator. The
modulator frequency is set as a ratio of the carrier, and the modulation
index controls harmonic richness. Drive it with notes_in from any note source,
and use NoteBreakout when downstream envelopes or filters need shared per-voice
control lanes.
tips: Integer mod_ratio values produce harmonic timbres; non-integer values create bell-like inharmonic sounds.

params.name: mod_ratio
params.doc: Modulator frequency as a multiple of the carrier.

params.name: mod_index
params.doc: Depth of frequency modulation. Higher = more harmonics.
